# Keep a package removal claim at the packaging boundary

The osclientcerts change removes the Windows and supported macOS library entries from package-manifest.in. It does not modify certificate APIs, preference behavior or client-certificate tests in this landing. Describe the removed packaged artifact and platform conditions precisely; a manifest-only diff does not establish removal of the whole certificate feature or a successful package build. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Certificate library packaging scope.
